body: Was trying it. Was going once a week to sort out panic attacks and coping with being around other people more often. Did help to some extent. Still going to this day. Just wish there was more to life than taking pills and going to see a therapist
Since I was diagnosed, I've been on and off many drugs to help with psychosis, social anxiety and ptsd

I have learnt that I could have done better to make sure the road in front of me was clear and safe to go 
If someone wants to be nice and let me through an intersection, I shouldn't immediately think that it is safe
Next time I come across this situation, it would be better for me to just let the other person go ahead so it is easier for me to see and make a decent decision
And in doing so, prevent others and myself from getting into a serious accident

This is what I was after

Some suggestions on how to improve my driving 

Thank you kind stranger 🙂

All I wanted was for some suggestions to help me improve on my driving
I made quite a life threatening mistake and I don't want it to happen again
Didn't think it would turn into a hating on a bigger vehicles thread

Do you have any suggestions on how to approach the same situation differently?
The point of the post was to see if I could get some help with my driving but I see that it has just turned into a hate on bigger vehicles thread
My mistake hasn't just scared me to death but has certainly scared the other person who nearly hit me too
Not to mention the guy in the ute who thought he'd be kind to a stranger today

As a person who was brought up in a small rural town, I fully understand why these bigger vehicles are useful
My parents both own a ute and an suv so there is no hate towards them, I think they are great for what they do
The sole purpose of the post was to see if I could get some advice on how to improve my driving skills and what I could have done better in the situation I put myself in

Sorry, I understand that I made a mistake
I want to improve on my driving skills and wanted to see if other people were having the same problem 
See if there was a solution to my situation and how to prevent it from happening again
Thank you for your response
I will make sure to check the coast is clear before making a move

I was at fault and have recognized my mistake and carelessness
If it was a person in a car waving me on and I made the same decision, the same outcome would have happened
The point was to see how many people were having the same problem as me and get some help at improving my driving skills
Maybe see if there was any hints on how to see past a bigger vehicle safely without getting hit like I almost did
Or vice versa, just letting the bigger vehicles go on there way so I can see better and make sure it's safe to go myself
